cells.label: Homeloans / Banking
cells.regulatoryDefinition:
This item shall reflect the aggregate amount of interest income from loans secured by a mortgage on occupied urban residential dwellings or individual sectional title dwellings that are, will be, or are rented with the consent of the obligors. It includes loans where the property is occupied by the borrower or rented out under approved conditions. additionally it  shall include all asset and liability items other than the asset and liability items designated in terms of the reporting bank's board-approved policy as constituting part of the bank's trading activities.
1. Excluding foreign branches
